usageNotes: Use this endpoint to inspect what changes a package update will introduce before applying it — useful for change-control review or auditing upgrade risk. The node must be reachable and the package must exist in the APT cache on that node; if no version is specified, the candidate (available-to-install) version's changelog is returned. Requires the System.Modify privilege, so API tokens scoped below that level will receive a permission error.

examples.summary: Fetch the changelog for the candidate version of proxmox-datacenter-manager on node pdm01

tips: Omitting 'version' returns the changelog for the candidate (newest available) version, which is the most useful for pre-upgrade review.
The response is a plain text string (Debian-style changelog), not JSON — handle it as raw text in your client.
If the package is not in the local APT cache, the node may return an error; run an apt update equivalent first if the package was recently published.
